title: What is alerting, since when, how high the CPU is, what alerted yesterday and this week, and who acknowledged what

turns.answer: `4` open alerts, `3` of them not acknowledged. The critical one is `High CPU` on `core-sw1.example.net`. The other three are `Port down`: `Gi0/0/0` on edge-rtr1, `Gi1/0/48 (to core-sw1)` on access-sw2, and `Gi0/0/1 (WAN: transit-b)` on edge-rtr1, which someone acknowledged.

turns.user: Since when is the CPU one?

turns.answer: `CPU 0` on core-sw1 reads `97 %`, past its warning limit of `75.0`: status `warning`.

turns.user: What about yesterday? Did anything alert then?
turns.answer: The same rule on the same switch: `High CPU` alerted at `2026-10-27T21:00:00Z` and `recovered` at `2026-10-27T22:00:00Z`. Everything else in the alert log is from today.

turns.user: Which device has alerted most this week?
turns.answer: `edge-rtr1.example.net`: `Port down` was raised there twice, last at `2026-10-28T10:02:00Z`, and has not cleared. core-sw1 comes next with the one `High CPU` alert of yesterday evening. Nothing flapped.

turns.user: Who acknowledged the transit-b alert, and why?
turns.answer: `alice`, at 09:15 today, with the note `carrier ticket 4411`.
